Survival Instincts Overview
Survival Instincts is a sidebar skill for animal-characters that provides utility skills and a replacement for armor patching.
In-Game Description
The ability of self-aware animals to enhance their natural instincts into finely-honed combat techniques. Only animals can use this skill.
Training Survival Instincts
Mittens
from the
Fox Outpost
in
Kur Mountains
teaches Survival Instincts at Comfortable.
Sanja
, also located in the
Kur Mountains
unlocks levels 51-60, 61-70, and teaches Lend Grace and abilities for levels 51-70.
Backfat
in the
Fae Realm
unlocks level 71-80 and teaches techniques in that level range.
Levels 81-90 are unlocked by
Serendipity Cheddar
deep beneath
Povus
.
